name: Club Suicide
source:
Spring has just begun, and graduation is just seven days away.
A group of students long to die now more than ever.
It’s been a long time since you last went to school. The pressure of having to build and maintain relationships was just too much for you.
But now you’re back. While you’re walking through the stairwell, you notice an unusual club flyer.
The name of the club is Club Suicide.

There’s no particular reason as to why you feel this way, but you’ve actually been thinking about committing suicide for some time now.
Out of a mix of curiosity and genuine interest, you decide to take a peek at the club’s first meeting that very afternoon.

It catches you completely off-guard how serious the other five members are about dealing with their lingering regrets before taking their own lives in the next seven days.
Fear quickly consumes you as you finally realize that you don’t want to die.

However, after already stating to the other members that you want to die as well, you have no choice but to stick with your lie until the seven days are up…

And so begins a strange and horrifying seven days in which you follow and learn more about these boys on their journeys to clear up any lingering regrets they may have before they finally commit suicide.

translation:
春天刚刚开始，距离毕业还有7天。
一群学生现在比以往任何时候都更渴望死亡。
距离你上次上学已经过去很长时间了。建立和维持关系的压力对你来说太大了。
但现在你回来了。当你穿过楼梯间时，你注意到一张不寻常的俱乐部传单。
俱乐部的名字是“自杀俱乐部”。

你有这种感觉并没有什么特别的原因，但你实际上已经考虑自杀有一段时间了。
出于好奇和真正的兴趣，你决定看一眼俱乐部当天下午的第一次会议。

它让你完全措手不及，其他五名成员在接下来的7天内结束自己的生命之前，是多么认真地处理他们挥之不去的遗憾。
当你终于意识到你不想死时，恐惧很快就会吞噬你。

然而，在已经向其他成员表示你也想死后，你别无选择，只能坚持你的谎言，直到七日结束……

奇怪而恐怖的七天就这样开始了，在这七天里，你将跟随并了解这些男孩的旅程，以消除他们在最终自杀之前可能留下的任何挥之不去的遗憾。
